"''Setting shields double forward.|Kent and Cail-tan|audio=Kent-Cail-tan-SC8.flac|}} '''Cail-tan''' was a [[human]] [[X-wing starfighter]] [[pilot]] for the [[New Republic]]. Around [[9 ABY]] their squadron was [[Invasion of At Attin|deployed]] to the [[planet]] [[At Attin]] in order to repel a [[Silvo's pirates|group]] of [[pirate]]s that had invaded. ==Biography== Cail-tan was a [[human]] who served in the [[New Republic]] as an [[X-wing starfighter]] [[pilot]]. During the [[New Republic Era]], the [[astronomer]] [[Kh'ymm]] contacted the New Republic on behalf of a [[Skeleton Crew|group]] of [[youngling]]s who where requesting help from a [[Silvo's pirates|group]] of [[pirate]]s that had [[Invasion of At Attin|invaded]] their [[Homeworld|home]] [[planet]] [[At Attin]]. Their squadron of eight [[T-65 X-wing starfighter]]s was deployed along with two [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter]]s and a [[CR90 corvette]] to repeal the pirates. As they approached the planet and the [[Silvo's pirate frigate|pirate frigate]], [[Commander]] [[Kent]] instructed the squadron to lock their [[S-foils]] in attack positions. Cail-tan further set their [[Starfighter|fighter's]] [[deflector shield]] to double forward. Afterward the squadron began their attack on the pirate [[frigate]]. The squadron eventually destroyed the frigate which crashed down into the [[Unidentified city (At Attin)|city]] below. ==Personality and traits== Cail-tan had tan skin, long brown [[hair]] and brown [[eye]]s. During their attack on the pirates on At Attin they had their hair braided and draped to their right side. ==Equipment== Cail-tan wore an blue [[flight suit]] with and a white [[K-22995 light flight helmet]]. The helmet had a yellow strip between two blue stripes down the center of the helmet with a yellow New Republic [[Starbird (symbol)|starbird]] [[Sigil of the New Republic|symbol]] on each side of it. They had a red and blue [[victory decal]] on each side of their helmet. ==Behind the scenes== Cail-tan was portrayed by [[Caitlan Shera Moore]] in "[[The Real Good Guys]]," the eighth episode of the [[Disney+]] live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'', which aired on [[January 14]], [[2025]].{{Twitter|starwars|status/1861409832349172011|''[[Star Wars]]''|date=2024-11-26|quote=Mark your calendars. 🗓️ On December 2, stream the two-episode series premiere of #SkeletonCrew, only on @DisneyPlus.|archiveurl=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/uxgSx|archivefile=File:StarWars-SkeletonCrewSchedule-Twitter.png}} The character's name is not spoken in the episode but was listed in the credits. ==Appearances== *{{SkeletonCrew|The Real Good Guys}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Mediacat|soundcat=Audio files of Cail-tan}} {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ja=ケイル＝タン |ka=კეილ-ტანი }} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]] [[Category:New Republic Starfighter Corps personnel]]
